hook.en: Draw the energy levels of electrons as they travel from water to NADP⁺ and you get a zig-zag shape like the letter Z. Along that path, light energy becomes ATP and NADPH.
hook.kn: ನೀರಿನಿಂದ NADP⁺ ವರೆಗೆ ಸಾಗುವ ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್‌ಗಳ ಶಕ್ತಿಮಟ್ಟಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆದರೆ Z ಆಕಾರ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳಕಿನ ಶಕ್ತಿ ATP ಮತ್ತು NADPH ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Explain the Z scheme and the splitting of water.

title.en: Z scheme and splitting of water

body.en: In PS II, the reaction centre absorbs 680 nm light; electrons are excited and passed to an electron acceptor, then down an electron transport chain of cytochromes to PS I. There the electrons are excited again by 700 nm light and passed to another acceptor and finally to NADP⁺, reducing it to NADPH + H⁺. This whole path, PS II → PS I → NADP⁺, is the Z scheme because of its shape when drawn on a redox scale. PS II replaces its lost electrons by splitting water: 2H₂O → 4H⁺ + O₂ + 4e⁻. The water-splitting complex is associated with PS II, which lies on the inner side of the thylakoid membrane, so the protons and oxygen are released into the lumen.

points.en: Electrons flow: H₂O → PS II → cytochromes → PS I → NADP⁺.
Water splitting is linked to PS II.
O₂ is a by-product of the light reaction.

narration.en: In PS II, the reaction centre absorbs 680 nm light; electrons are excited and passed to an electron acceptor, then down an electron transport chain of cytochromes to PS I. There the electrons are excited again by 700 nm light and passed to another acceptor and finally to NADP⁺, reducing it to NADPH + H⁺. This whole path, PS II → PS I → NADP⁺, is the Z scheme because of its shape when drawn on a redox scale. PS II replaces its lost electrons by splitting water: 2H₂O → 4H⁺ + O₂ + 4e⁻. The water-splitting complex is associated with PS II, which lies on the inner side of the thylakoid membrane, so the protons and oxygen are released into the lumen.
narration.kn: ದ್ಯುತಿವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ II ರಿಂದ I ಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ NADP⁺ ಗೆ ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್‌ಗಳು ಸಾಗುವ ದಾರಿ Z ಯೋಜನೆ. ದ್ಯುತಿವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ II ನೀರನ್ನು ವಿಭಜಿಸಿ ಇಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನ್ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಮ್ಲಜನಕ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: ATP synthesis from ADP and inorganic phosphate in the presence of light is photophosphorylation. When both photosystems work in series, the electron flow is non-cyclic and produces ATP, NADPH and O₂. When only PS I works, the electron cycles back within the photosystem: cyclic flow, producing only ATP. Cyclic flow occurs in the stroma lamellae, whose membranes lack PS II and the NADP reductase enzyme, and when only light beyond 680 nm is available. ATP synthesis is explained by chemiosmosis: protons accumulate in the lumen (from water splitting and from the proton pumping by the electron carrier), and protons are removed from the stroma when NADP⁺ is reduced. The resulting proton gradient across the thylakoid membrane drives protons back to the stroma through the CF₀ channel of ATP synthase; the CF₁ head, protruding into the stroma, makes ATP.

points.en: Non-cyclic: PS II + PS I; ATP + NADPH + O₂.
Cyclic: PS I only; ATP only; stroma lamellae.
ATP synthase: CF₀ (channel in the membrane) + CF₁ (in the stroma).

narration.kn: ಬೆಳಕಿನ ಉಪಸ್ಥಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ATP ತಯಾರಿಕೆಯೇ ದ್ಯುತಿ ಫಾಸ್ಫೊರಿಲೀಕರಣ. ಚಕ್ರೀಯವಲ್ಲದ ಹರಿವು ATP, NADPH ಮತ್ತು O₂ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಚಕ್ರೀಯ ಹರಿವು ಕೇವಲ ATP ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಥೈಲಕಾಯ್ಡ್ ಪೊರೆಯ ಆಚೀಚೆ ಪ್ರೋಟಾನ್ ಇಳಿಜಾರು ATP ಸಿಂಥೇಸ್ ಮೂಲಕ ATP ತಯಾರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
